---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new tool or improvement
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

**What are you trying to do?**
A clear description of the problem or use case.

**Proposed solution**
What you'd like to see — a new tool, a change to an existing one, etc.

**Is this a new client-side tool?**
If so, check `do-it.md` and CLAUDE.md's "Build order" section first — the
project is built in phases and new tools should fit the client-side-first
principle (no data sent to a server unless the tool inherently requires a
backend, like DNS lookups or webhook testing).

**Alternatives considered**
Any other approaches you thought about.
